column1: B1 the undeclared wrap drops its sentinel (engine would read it as declared-but-unusable)
B2 failedFields keeps only the first failed field
B3 failedFields never reports (every compound binding passes)
B4 a config field is mislabelled (calendar_version says build_digest)
B5 a config binding term is dropped from the collection (and so from the decision)
B6 the read fault loses its cause (%v instead of %w)
B7 the read fault is reported as a digest mismatch (the two kinds merged back)
B8 the decode refusal is replaced by the bare sentinel
B9 an unknown lane also blames its table fields (known guard dropped)
B10 the expiry wrap drops the Expired sentinel
E1 the gate computation moves back after the proposal load
E2 the gate is computed before the route-readiness guard (RouteNotReady would carry it)
E3 the fail closure stops carrying the gate's activation
